title: After dispatch, state is still the old value

slides.say: You dispatch an action, then log the state. It still shows the old value.
Dispatch does not change state in the running code. It requests a new render with the new value.

slides.text: State is a snapshot. The variable in this render never changes.
slides.say: State behaves like a snapshot. The state variable in this render stays the same, even in a timeout later.
Need the next value now? Call the reducer yourself with the same state and action.
